name: Asset Reconstruction Company (India) Limited
summary: Asset Reconstruction Company (India) Limited operates as an asset reconstruction company, acquiring and resolving distressed assets and non-performing loans. The company acquires, manages, and resolves stressed assets across corporate, SME, and retail segments, providing asset reconstruction services that include acquisition of non-performing assets, restructuring, settlement, and sale of assets. It conducts property auctions, manages settlement processes related to distressed assets, and engages in insolvency and bankruptcy resolution processes under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, in partnership with insolvency professionals and legal firms.
